title: Holdco platform
goal: The first 'shot' offer page on the public internet with signups landing in a real database, so an idea is judged by real visitors instead of by opinion

project.why: Drafted 2026-09-10 from docs/HOLDCO_STRATEGY.md, IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md and GO_LIVE.md on the branch, last touched 2026-08-06; his to correct, or to drop if Barkly and the films replace it.

steps.text: Pick the one offer to test first and write it as one sentence in docs/NEXT_OFFER.md on the holdco branch (or tell any Claude session to)
Bring the platform up to date and confirm pnpm test, typecheck and build still pass (last verified 2026-08-06)
Build the shot page for the offer in docs/NEXT_OFFER.md, in apps/shots
Create the free Postgres database and hosting account (GO_LIVE.md steps 1 and 2, no cost)
Deploy the shots app, run the GO_LIVE.md smoke test, and send it its first visitors
